_comment: PROVEN ICF (identical-COMDAT-folding) symbol aliases for objdiff.
Retail RB3's /O1 build folds the debug-stripped 2-arg POOL_OVERLOAD
operator-new path into the named 5-arg debug allocator: both spellings
live at ONE address in the XEX, so only the 5-arg mangled name appears in
scripts/target_symbol_map.json. Our compiled objs emit the byte-IDENTICAL
call site (li r3,N / li r4,N / bl) but reference the 2-arg name, so objdiff
(which compares bl relocations BY NAME via objdiff-core reloc_eq) flags a
[sym] mismatch even though the machine code matches exactly.
This file declares the PROVEN folds. tools/gen_symbol_alias_map.py turns it
into an MSVC-linker-map-format file (build/45410914/icf_aliases.map) that
objdiff's existing symbol_equivalences mechanism (objdiff-core map_file.rs,
wired via objdiff.json 'map_file') consumes: symbols that share an address
in the map are treated as reloc-name-equal. NO objdiff source change needed.
GATE: each group is seeded ONLY by byte-identical-call-site evidence
(a paired 'bl <5arg>' / 'bl <2arg>' diff row where the relocation type and
addend match and the surrounding bytes are equal), NEVER by fuzzy matching.
Each group must contain EXACTLY ONE symbol that exists at a real address in
scripts/target_symbol_map.json (the survivor the ICF fold kept); the others
are the spellings our compiled code emits that the fold absorbed.
Each group's 'address' is the survivor's address in target_symbol_map.json
(used as the synthetic map address so parse_msvc_map groups them); it is NOT
load-bearing beyond being a unique per-group key.
VALIDATION: tools/icf_alias_finder.py --validate confirms (a) exactly one
survivor per group is in target_symbol_map.json, (b) every other spelling is
referenced by at least one of our compiled objs, and (c) at least one
function exhibits the paired-bl byte-identical-call-site signature.

groups.name: PoolAlloc
groups.evidence: POOL_OVERLOAD 2-arg operator-new (utl/PoolAlloc.h) folds onto the 5-arg debug PoolAlloc; target obj refs only the 5-arg name (142 objs), base emits the 2-arg (197 objs). Paired-bl signature confirmed in MidiParser/Utl/CharDriver.

groups.name: MemOrPoolAlloc
groups.evidence: 1-arg MemOrPoolAlloc/MemOrPoolAllocSTL (utl/MemMgr.h, debug-stripped) fold onto the 4-arg debug MemOrPoolAlloc; target obj refs only the 4-arg name (244 objs). Paired-bl diff_arg signature confirmed in DataArray (??0DataArray, LoadGlob, _M_create_node — including the cross-variant STL fold).
